title: Code Night
seo_title: Code Night in Springfield, MO – Weekly Work Session
description: Code Night is a weekly work session where product development teams build technology that helps the local or national community. Newcomers are welcome and are encouraged to contact the organizers on Discord to find a project that fits; food is not provided, though the group often shares a meal afterward. It takes place Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 6:30 PM at eFactory in The Perch, 405 N Jefferson Ave, Springfield, MO.
